fields.Name: ORD-03 - Subscriptions
fields.Description: SubscriptionType columns ARE the rules (SB1-SB12, D45/D46). Buying a subscription product materializes a Subscription plus a term-1 SubscriptionTerm with the recognition type FROZEN at purchase; calendar anchoring produces a partial first term that Prorate reduces and ChargeFull does not; ExtendExisting appends a contiguous term 2 while RejectDuplicate rejects the confirm; organization-only scope rejects an individual buyer; recognition entries anchor to the TERM while booking stays on the order line; and RecognitionCadence drives the slice count.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Jul-1 purchase of a Jan-1 anchored type yields a 2026-07-01..2026-12-31 term at 184/365 of list; extension starts the day after the prior term ends; quarterly cadence yields 4 slices where monthly yields 12.
